path_identity_scope: Source-file-set keys retain original private queue source_tree_sha256 identifiers; they are NOT recomputed hashes of these portable path maps. Per-file hashes bind exact bytes. Report basenames refer to private raw receipts. command_sha256 and queue_sha256 bind original private command/queue bytes, not portable commands. Archive paths are suggested preservation locations, not evidence those files already exist.
provenance_limits: Root attests all43 before/after source assertions and serial quiet execution in REPL transcript. Consolidation checks current hashes; it does not independently audit that transcript. Minimal receipts do not duplicate source snapshots or stdout/stderr digests/exact signing command receipts.
GP no emitted selected-ID hash; pinned successful probe validates witnesses; order differs from IPC.
Selected equality is not global producer fidelity proof.
Fresh process does not establish cold network/filesystem caches; ordered single trials, no confidence intervals.
No remote global census or GP catchments; prior R2 originals excluded from same-host comparisons.
